description: This Java class 'DescriptionProcessor' processes various objects such as HttpRequest, OpenAPIDefinition, and DashboardLogEntryDTO to generate descriptive representations and track maximum description lengths for each type.

classes.name: DescriptionProcessor
classes.description: A class that generates descriptions for various object types and tracks maximum description lengths for each type.

methods.name: getMaxHttpRequestLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of HttpRequest descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxOpenAPILength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of OpenAPIDefinition descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxOpenAPIObjectLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of OpenAPI object descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxLogEventLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of DashboardLogEntryDTO descriptions processed.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Generates a Description object for a given object, optionally with an ID, handling different object types.
